decision_rule_reachability.reason: Both D-PRIMARY branches are arithmetically reachable. The frozen-bank calibration probe (run via --mechanics-only on the embedded FROZEN-RUNNER) demonstrates CAL-FEASIBLE at t*=0 on all three axes: AXIS-PRIMARY (coverage 0.860, pooled_false_accept 0.100, unknown_precision 1.000), AXIS-ALTLEX (0.912/0.100/1.000), AXIS-HELDOUT (0.875/0.050/1.000). The accept region is non-empty. GATE-NOT-MET is also reachable: the test split uses disjoint phrasings, the parent's embedding gate collapsed to coverage 0.0 here, and the calibration split already contains 2 executed out-of-scope and 8 unresolved applicable goals proving the signal is not a perfect separator. D-ALTLEX/D-HELDOUT can reach RETAINED/LOST/MIXED/BLOCKED. Thresholds (0.10, 0.50, 0.85) are arithmetically attainable. Precedence (MEASUREMENT_INVALID > GATE-INVALID > GATE-NOT-MET > GATE-MET) has no branch that makes later branches unreachable.

baseline_identifiability.reason: Treatment T-LEX-AMBIG (deterministic resolver + integer ambiguity gate S) and comparators are genuinely distinct functions. B-LEX-ONLY is the same resolver without the gate; V9 requires their execution vectors to differ on >= 1 primary goal (calibration probe shows 7 resolved goals abstained by S>0, so test split will differ). A-EMBED-COSINE loads a dense embedding model; V9 requires the primary path to reference no embedder (verified: 'sentence_transformers', 'torch', 'EmbeddingArgmaxResolver' absent from primary path). The frozen bank is not lexically trivial: B-LEX-ONLY executes 49/57 applicable on calibration, 8 applicable goals are structurally unresolved. Arms are neither constant-execute nor constant-abstain and share no trivial reparameterization. Arm accuracies and gate triplet are outcomes not measured in DESIGN.

control_sensitivity.reason: Every gated control has a concrete failure mode under the same implementation. PC-LIVENESS-AND-INTEGRITY: 3 sub-checks (fixture uniqueness 20/20, incumbent verbatim resolution 20/20, B-LEX-STRONG self-match 20/20) can fail on duplicate/ambiguous fixture, broken registry/loader/threshold, or lexicon that cannot resolve its own canonical intents. NC-SHUFFLED-LABEL fails if deterministic selection tracks deranged labels; NC-CONSTANT-SIGNAL fails if a constant signal reaches unknown_precision >= 0.85 (exposing broken credit/denominator). CTRL-EXEC-ALL/CTRL-ABSTAIN-ALL/CTRL-RANDOM-GATE bound the gate triplet from extremes and matched-coverage. V2/V3 fail on degenerate primary set (<80 applicable) or >20 contamination flags (V3 non-vacuous: 9 AXIS-PRIMARY flags reproduce parent, 0 AXIS-HELDOUT). V5-V13 fail on their named states. All controls are arithmetically fallible.
evidence_refs: DESIGN probe: 9 AXIS-PRIMARY flags (7 applicable, 2 out-of-scope), reproducing the parent

treatment_liveness.reason: T-LEX-AMBIG is proven live and non-degenerate on the frozen bank by the calibration-only DESIGN probe (--mechanics-only). rationale: All six satisfiability/identifiability checks pass. The design cleanly isolates the one sub-mechanism the parent left unidentified (whether the deterministic resolver's own ambiguity signal can supply a safe abstention gate) with a both-directions falsifier on a disjoint calibration/test split, while adding generalization probes (held-out mechanism set, independent lexicon) that the parent's 113-goal set could not provide. The accept branch is demonstrably reachable (CAL-FEASIBLE at t*=0 on all three axes); the negative branch is reachable by construction (parent's embedding gate collapsed here, test phrasings are disjoint, signal is not a perfect separator). All controls are live and fallible. All prerequisites are satisfied for the model-free primary path. All mutable artifacts are frozen and hash-bound. No blocking findings.
